description: A React abstract class component for admin settings in Mattermost, handling configuration state, form submission, and error display.

classes.name: OLDAdminSettings
classes.description: An abstract React component class for managing admin configuration settings, including state management, form handling, and API interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to derive component state from configuration.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Abstract method to derive configuration from component state.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Abstract method to render the title section.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Abstract method to render the settings UI.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to form inputs, updating state and navigation blocking.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission event, triggers doSubmit.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Performs async save operation, updates state based on success or error.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Parses string to integer with default fallback.

methods.name: parseIntNonNegative
methods.description: Parses string or number to non-negative integer with default fallback.

methods.name: parseIntZeroOrMin
methods.description: Parses string or number to integer, ensuring minimum value.

methods.name: parseIntNonZero
methods.description: Parses string or number to non-zero integer with default fallback.

methods.name: getConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves nested config value by dot-separated path.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets nested config value by dot-separated path.

methods.name: isSetByEnv
methods.description: Checks if a config path is set by environment config.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the configuration form with header, settings, save button, and error message.
